messages:
mia: Heads-up: I'm opening a docs PR to consolidate rate-limit migration + quota dashboard examples. Need a quick review on the SDK snippet for the v2 header changes and the embed usage example. Draft: https://git.redwood/docs/patch/1234 — will push in ~30m
connor: On it. Which dashboard links need updates? I remember panel IDs changed in prod.
mia: dash panels: /dash/usage-overview -> now /dash/usage-summary (panel id 72 -> 94). The current sample still points at the old path; also the SDK header example shows X-Redwood-Api-Key instead of Authorization: Bearer. Small patch in code needed.
leo: I can handle the panel links + add a short note about burst credits edge-case. Also suggest adding a backoff headers snippet. Quick sample: ```python
import os
from redwood import Client
client = Client(authorization=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_BEARER'))
resp = client.generate('Summarize this')
print(resp.text)
``` — but we should show Authorization: Bearer style in the HTTP example too.
amanda: Let's not print env vars. Use a placeholder and mention env var usage in comments. I'll submit a tiny PR to replace the snippet.
connor: :thumbsup: I'll review the PR. Also confirm: does Dedicated still expose meter 'token_units' vs 'tokens'? We should standardize wording.
mia: 'tokens' is canonical now — migration guide should show mapping (token_units -> tokens) and a small example script converting metrics.
leo: Who will add the migration note to release notes? We should call out SDK v2.1 changes and panel rename.
mia: I'll add it to release-notes/2.1 entry. Also need someone to smoke-test the code examples in the docs playground — a few fail because of a missing import.
amanda: I'll run them and post results.
docs-bot: Reminder: docs CI will run spellcheck + snippet tests on PRs. Tagging @connor for required approvals.
connor: Got the tag. Expect review in the next hour. One more request — the quota examples for tiered billing reference 'tier_id' but our API now uses 'plan_slug'. Please update those examples.
mia: Good catch. I'll update the draft before opening the PR.
amanda: Test results: all snippets pass locally except the streaming example (hangs on our test harness). Investigating — probably missing chunk_size param.
leo: For streaming, add an explicit stream_timeout and chunk_size in examples and note Dedicated may need larger timeouts (network and proxy quirks). Eg add: `stream_timeout=10` in snippet.
connor: LGTM once changes applied. @mia please ping when PR is up so I can approve.
mia: PR opened: https://git.redwood/docs/pr/987 — reviewers: @connor @amanda @leo. Thanks everyone!
